title: Show queue source scan tiles
summary: Replaced the Queue source inventory raw filename block with a tile board that surfaces scan freshness, queue size, launch readiness, top blocker, work mix, largest preview item, filter impact, and source-root coverage. Full inventory text remains available behind a details disclosure.
reason: The raw source inventory list was hard to scan and prioritized long paths over operator decisions. The Queue panel now highlights the information most useful before launch review while keeping backend queue and scan authority unchanged.
behavior_before: The Source Scan And Display Filters panel rendered source inventory evidence as a scrolling text block with long filenames and sizes.
behavior_after: The panel renders a responsive tile board for high-value source scan and queue decision signals, with the full inventory text moved into an expandable details block.
